items.title: Flashcards
items.text: Study, Cards: review what's due, and old cards come back on the right day.

items.title: Quiz me
items.text: A quiz on screen from a topic or your notes file. Wrong answers become flashcards.

items.title: Your week
items.text: Show my week draws your study days, focus time and what's next. Every Sunday too.

items.title: Exam countdown
items.text: A small badge on your desktop: days to your exam and today's topics.

items.title: Bigger cards
items.text: Appearance, Theme: make the cards I draw bigger and easier to read.

items.title: Smooth 3D and photos
items.text: 3D models and photos on cards now show in full colour.

items.title: Stays awake while showing
items.text: I no longer doze off while a card I drew is still up.

items.title: Meet Peri, Nova and Sprout
items.text: Three new buddies drawn by Naveen. Pick one in Companion Persona.

items.title: A Study page
items.text: Deadlines, courses, a course map, a calendar and your GPA, all in one place.

items.title: Exam prep
items.text: SSC, UPSC, GATE and more: a daily plan by subject, revision and mock scores.

items.title: Focus timer and streak
items.text: Focus for 25 or 50 minutes from Study, and keep a daily study streak.

items.title: Panic key
items.text: Ctrl+Shift+X stops me talking and listening and hides everything at once.

items.title: Point and ask
items.text: Ctrl+Shift+Y asks about whatever is under your mouse.

items.title: Light, dark or system
items.text: Pick a theme for this window, my bubbles and my cards in Persona.

items.title: Email drafts
items.text: I can open a ready draft in Gmail or Outlook for you to check and send.

items.title: Replays without AI
items.text: Keep the steps of a walkthrough and I replay them instantly next time.

items.title: Keys fit their card
items.text: The talk and type keys no longer spill out of their card.

items.title: Hi, I'm My Buddy
items.text: A fresh Electric Cyan look: rounded glass cards, a clean font and a new name.

items.title: Errands in your own Chrome
items.text: With the My Buddy extension on, I can work your signed-in Chrome in a background tab.

items.title: Say Hey Buddy
items.text: The wake word is now Hey Buddy. Turn it on in Listening.

items.title: Asks before a final cancel
items.text: Buttons like Finish Cancellation now always ask you first.
